content: Rohan Deshmukh contacted insurance agent Karan Joshi to inquire about a missing $123.45 refund. Karan confirmed the refund was processed on September 24 and explained that bank transfers can take up to 3 business days, meaning it might still be in transit. Karan provided Rohan with the transaction reference number (REF-2026-HP5678-001) for his records, and Rohan agreed to monitor his bank account.

action_items: Rohan will keep an eye on his bank account for the refund
